notes: Expected segment IDs are stable provider-declared IDs, never synthetic filename identities.
Observed requires matched_rows >= 1 and exactly one complete selected source.
Counts are published dimensional event counts, never unique users or unsuppressed population totals.
Event counts are nonnegative. Explicit USD money can be finite and negative.
A complete transfer cannot prove an absent event was zero.
The legacy complete_funnel flag is false for v2. Consumers validate selected metric evidence.
All retained metrics are nullable. Unsupported identity populations remain unknown.
